name: AMCL
description: Adaptive Monte Carlo Localization for a mobile robot. Uses particle filter to estimate robot pose.

name: GMapping
description: Gmapping is a ROS wrapper for OpenSlam's GMapping. Creates 2D occupancy grid maps from laser data.

name: SICK Scan Driver
description: Driver for SICK TIM series laser scanners. Provides laser scan data for navigation and mapping.

name: Velodyne Driver
description: Driver for Velodyne 3D LiDAR scanners. Provides point cloud data for 3D perception.

name: IMU Driver
description: Driver for Inertial Measurement Unit sensors. Provides orientation and angular velocity data.

name: Move Base
description: Navigation stack for mobile robots. Combines global and local path planning with obstacle avoidance.

name: Global Planner
description: Global path planning component. Calculates optimal path from current position to goal.

name: Local Planner
description: Local path planning and obstacle avoidance. Generates velocity commands for robot movement.

name: Base Controller
description: Low-level controller for robot base movement. Converts velocity commands to motor signals.

name: Joint Controller
description: Controller for individual robot joints. Handles position, velocity, and effort control.

name: Object Detection
description: Computer vision component for detecting and classifying objects in camera images.

name: Point Cloud Processor
description: Processes 3D point cloud data for obstacle detection and environment understanding.
